about: Hach & Rose works from Madison Avenue and publishes twenty-three attorneys with a rank beside every name, partners, of counsel and associates among them. That is the largest attorney roster in this ranking, and this cohort carried the firm's other domain, hachroselaw.com, as unresolved until this pass.

277 reviews at 4.8. It publishes 123 case results with amounts of its own, the longest such list in the directory, and seven bar association memberships on its bios. A free consultation, published, and no contingency statement or Spanish pages we could read.
